capabilities: color graph nodes by metric (recency, links, word count, file size)
filter the graph to subsets like orphans, hubs, stale notes, and stubs
show a hover tooltip with each node's metric value and rank
blend recently modified nodes toward a configurable halo color
switch metric, palette, scale, and focus mode from an in-graph control panel
extras: Uses undocumented Obsidian internals (renderer.nodes[].color), so colors may silently stop updating after Obsidian updates; install currently via BRAT or manually until accepted into the official community list.
intentEvidence: hooks Obsidian's layout-change, active-leaf-change, and vault.modify events, plus a 2-second tick
problem: Obsidian's graph view has no way to color nodes by metadata-driven metrics or to isolate subsets like unlinked or stale notes.

relations.evidence: the same pattern as other graph plugins like Extended Graph

summary: Plugin that colors graph view nodes by recency, connectedness, word count, or file size and filters the graph to orphans, hubs, stale notes, or stubs.
